# Equations for Podosome Model

[Cdc42*] = $C_a$ \
[Cdc42] = $C_i$ \
[ARHGAP17*] = $G_a$ \
[ARHGAP17] = $G_i$ \
[Actin] = $A$ \
[R] = $R$ \
[M] = $M$ \
$$
H(x, k_{max}, k, n) = \frac{k_{max} x^n}{k^n + x^n}
$$
$$
\frac{dC_a}{dt} = S_{signal}C_i(S_0 + S_1C_a^2 ) - C_a\left(\delta_0 + \delta_1G_a \right) 
$$

$$
C_i = C_t-C_a
$$
$$
\frac{dG_a}{dt} = G_i(S_0 + S_1C_a) - G_a ( \delta_0 + \delta_1A  )
$$
$$
G_i = G_t - G_a
$$

$$
\frac{dA}{dt} = S_0 + S_1C_a - A ( \delta_0 + \delta_1 M)
$$


$$
\frac{dR}{dt} = S_0 + S_1G_a - R( \delta_0 + \delta_1 M)
$$

$$
\frac{dM}{dt} = S_0 + S_1R - \delta_0M
$$
